'''Ralf Blobelt EJP Hidden Base''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ralf Blobelt]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls107.htm EJP Hidden Base], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228021008/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls107.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
